question: Where’s the closest golf course found toward the southeast of 3 Palms Zoo & Education Center, Townsend, DE?
sql: WITH zoo_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%3 Palms Zoo & Education Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Townsend%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%DE%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT name, distance_meters FROM ( SELECT poi_name AS name, ST_Distance(P.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM zoo_location)::geography) AS distance_meters, degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT geometry FROM zoo_location), P.geometry)) AS bearing_degrees FROM pois AS P WHERE P.leisure = 'golf_course' UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, ST_Distance(PA.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM zoo_location)::geography) AS distance_meters, degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT geometry FROM zoo_location), PA.geometry)) AS bearing_degrees FROM parks AS PA WHERE PA.leisure = 'golf_course' ) AS golf_courses_with_bearing WHERE bearing_degrees BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5 ORDER BY distance_meters ASC LIMIT 1;
